narrative.overview: Assistant-IA's visual system embodies the calm, unyielding precision of an air traffic control console or financial trading terminal. In an enterprise customer support environment, counselors operate under high cognitive throughput: reviewing customer grievances, inspecting AI-retrieved source chunks, claiming escalated threads, and composing decisive replies.
keyCharacteristics: Zero-Tolerance Anti-Slop: No purple neon gradients, sparkles, or fake progress rings
Strict Semantic Lifecycle Chromatics (BOT indigo, PENDING_HUMAN amber, HUMAN_ACTIVE emerald, CLOSED slate)
Tabular & Monospace Rigor for timestamps, token meters, and chunk coordinates
Tonal Layering over Heavy Drops: 1px structural borders and subtle elevation

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: Primary accent (#4F46E5) must cover less than 8% of any rendered viewport.

rules.name: The State Tint Rule
rules.body: Lifecycle states must pair their primary text color with a 12% opacity wash of the exact same hue.

rules.name: The Single-Sans Discipline Rule
rules.body: Never combine distinct display and body sans-serif typefaces. The entire operational interface uses Inter.

rules.name: The Numeric Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every timestamp, duration, and quantitative metric must render with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Elevation-By-State Rule
rules.body: Shadows must never appear on resting static elements, only on floating overlays.

dos: Do format all timestamps and metrics with monospace or tabular numbers
Do display the exact RAG chunk citations that generated an autonomous response
Do maintain a strict 4.5:1 minimum contrast ratio across all text and icon indicators
donts: Don't use purple-to-pink gradient text, pulsing neon glows, or glowing robot avatars
Don't nest cards inside cards; use typographic hierarchy and 1px dividers
Don't place eyebrow kickers above main headings
